'''Negamo''' was a seasoning used in cooking. The [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] used a pitch of negamo to make the [[apple slug stew]] that he sold at this at his [[Dex's Diner/Legends|diner]]<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> located on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> Negamo could be consumed by members of the [[Wookiee/Legends|wookiee]] [[species]] and members of [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Gormaanda/Legends|Gormaanda's]] [[Gormaanda's species|species]]. In a cooking [[Holovid/Legends|holovid]], Gormaanda prepared [[Bantha Surprise]] using a dash of negamo. While adding the ingredient to a large pot containing the [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]] meat, Gormaanda took a bite of negamo for herself.<ref name="Holiday Special" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="Holiday Special date">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=870#15778940|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Tasty Taste]]|date=2006-10-12|time=6:13 PM|quote=Wookiee Life Day occurs every 3 years, one of which fell at ~1.5 ABY.}}</ref> the Wookiee [[Mallatobuck/Legends|Mallatobuck]] used Gormaanda's holovid to prepare Bantha Suprise for her [[Chewbacca's family/Legends|family's]] [[Life Day/Legends|Life Day]] celebrations<ref name="Holiday Special" /> on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].<ref name="Holiday Special" />

==Behind the scenes==
Negamo first appeared in the ''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Television special|television special]]<ref name="Holiday Special">''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]''</ref> released in [[1978]].<ref name="Boba Fett: Mystery Man">{{GalaxyCite|1|Boba Fett: Mystery Man in Not-So-Shining Armor}}</ref>
